patches.title: Starter industry and salvage
changes: Network Node construction now requires 8 of each component item, reduced from 10.
All salvage cuts into Debris. Refining 10 Debris produces 6 Salvaged Materials, 2 Aromatic Carbon Weave, 2 Nickel-Iron Veins and 6 Silicon Dust.
The starter refining task uses Debris instead of Cinderwrack. The official known-issues list warns that tutorial text still mentions the old output.
Collier and Shifter scan ranges increased. Inculcator Foundations request specific materials from their drones.
Regolith and industrial-product descriptions were corrected. The blueprint tracker and several logout/warp fuel-loss problems were fixed.

patches.title: Fuel and material hotfix
changes: A new recipe converts 21 Hydrocarbon Residue into 75 D1 Fuel. It is available on the Material Processor, Refinery module, Refinery and Heavy Refinery.
The Water Ice input for D1 Fuel is 208, reduced from 275. The patch does not state the output quantity for that recipe.
Hydrated Gossan Matrix yields only Water Ice, with increased yield. Crustal Anorthosite Crystals yield more Hydrocarbon Residue, less Silica Grains and some Iron-Rich Nodules.
Carbon Weave requires 15 Hydrocarbon Residue. Thermal Composites require 6 Hydrocarbon Residue and 4 Silica Grains.
The Residue-to-Troilite/Tholin conversion was removed from the starter Material Processor and Refinery module, but remains on the Refinery.

patches.title: Vestiges foundations
changes: New characters start in a Reiver. The Docking Clamp enables physical docking; starter and advanced onboard industry are separated.
Aim Flight is the default, with strafing and rolling. Ship handling depends more directly on engines, thrusters and fittings.
Exploration is character-specific. Public solar-system, constellation and character-jump API endpoints were removed; client strings are not a live or discovered-universe catalog.
Nine skills grow through deepening Memories. Crowns carry up to six Memories; Ascension banks acquired depth. Pathways were removed.
Mining produces Regoliths across Silicate, Carbonaceous, Metallic, Sulfide and Volatile families. New Conservator Collier and Shifter drones mine and salvage.
